capabilities.name: 客户端与玩家测试
capabilities.description: 准备隔离的 Minecraft 测试实例，进行有界面或无头启动测试、玩家操作、截图与场景验证。

capabilities.name: 服务端测试
capabilities.description: 启动、停止和验证本机服务器，管理服务端核心、联机测试、日志与命令场景，生成和导出服务端包。

capabilities.name: 自动检查
capabilities.description: 运行客户端、专用服务器、GameTest 和构建矩阵；生成持续集成工作流。

tools.name: modmind_build_status
tools.description: Read the active managed build state and whether it can be cancelled. Does not start a build or game. Network timeout protection applies to new build Java processes after this feature update.

tools.name: modmind_cancel_build
tools.description: Cancel only the current project managed build and await process cleanup. Does not stop an independently running game or delete project files/caches. If status is cancelling, query modmind_build_status again before retrying.

tools.name: modmind_local_server
tools.description: Manage the current project local server: state, start, stop, command or scenario. Uses managed core downloads and isolated persistent instances. Start does not prove plugin behavior; scenario requires fresh expected evidence.

tools.name: modmind_test_rendered
tools.description: Build/sync and launch the current Java mod/modpack with the bundled background Agent. Returns an actual framebuffer image, then stops the owned client. Inspect images before claiming visual or gameplay correctness. Startup is asynchronous: poll the returned taskId until completed; cancel stops preparation.

tools.name: modmind_test_session
tools.description: Manage an owned game session: capabilities/start/state/stop, pause/resume AI input or takeover for human input. Rendered Java mod/modpack/plugin sessions default to the bundled background Agent, independent of control Mod catalogs. Start returns sessionId immediately; poll state until ready. The game retains real rendering and independent virtual input; hidden/minimized/locked states are not guaranteed. Legacy backend remains explicit; headless cannot prove visuals. Stop only owned processes.

tools.name: modmind_test_observe
tools.description: Read current background input/render state or bounded client logs. operation=result with requestId checks an earlier action without repeating it. Background observations do not invent GUI, inventory or world semantics. Use test_capture for visible evidence.

tools.name: modmind_test_action
tools.description: Operate the game through virtual keyboard/mouse: click/double_click, move, look(dx,dy relative pixels), drag(x,y,toX,toY), scroll, text, key/key_down/key_up, button_down/button_up, combo(keys), wait or batch(steps). Screenshot pixel coordinates require revision from latest test_capture; resizing/recreating invalidates it. Hold leases <=5000ms; batch <=32 steps and 10s. requestId deduplicates retries; query observe result after uncertainty. capture=true returns a later real image. release/cancel clear owned input. inventory/close use E/Escape; command types chat and needs in-game permissions. Completion means input and later render processed, never gameplay success.

tools.name: modmind_test_capture
tools.description: Capture a fresh real framebuffer image, returned as MCP image content with frameId, timestamp, dimensions and revision. Click/drag/move use pixels of this returned image, not desktop coordinates. Paused/human sessions remain observable. No stale frames or headless images are presented as current visuals.

tools.name: modmind_test_scenario
tools.description: Legacy backend text-assertion scenarios. For background sessions use test_action batch followed by capture and inspect the actual image; no semantic game-state assertions are fabricated.

tools.name: modmind_test_matrix
tools.description: Run selected managed build, client, server, or GameTest targets.

tools.name: modmind_test_minecraft
tools.description: Build and launch the isolated ModMind Minecraft test instance, then return startup/crash evidence.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_build_server
tools.description: Deterministically build the initial server pack by invoking the pinned open-source ServerPackCreator CLI. This tool does not use AI, does not modify the AI workspace, and excludes unknown-side mods by default; return the generated manifest, skipped mods, engine version and log path.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_verify_server_join
tools.description: Build a loopback-only local server in offline test mode, wait for its ready port, and verify a HeadlessMC client joins with transcript evidence. Set onlineMode true only for an explicit authenticated-server test.

tools.name: modmind_modpack_run_server_scenario
tools.description: Run bounded server console/log scenarios. fixture + operation=start pins Minecraft/Loader versions and authorized JAR paths with SHA-256 in a fresh offline loopback world. acceptEula must be true. Returns taskId; poll operation=state with taskId and waitSeconds<=20, operation=files lists authorized JARs, cancel stops only that task. Without operation or fixture retain the existing full-pack scenario. Results distinguish declared and log-observed mods.

tools.name: modmind_runtime_state
tools.description: Read the current isolated Minecraft test runtime state and recent events. Modpacks also return modpackImport with installed counts, pending dependencies and original-pack compatibility warnings; import success does not prove gameplay compatibility.
